svg.aria-label: The stages of a manuscript and the mode of the paper skill each request runs. Write: Help me plan my paper; /paper plan; Review the literature on a topic; /paper lit-review; Outline a paper; /paper outline-only; Write a paper; /paper full | Submit: Write an abstract; /paper abstract-only; Convert my paper to DOCX, or the citations to another style; /paper format-convert; Write an AI disclosure statement; /paper disclosure | Desk reject: Revise the manuscript on the editor's comments; /paper revision; Format it for another journal; /paper format-convert | Referee revision: Parse the reviewer comments; /paper revision-coach; Revise the manuscript on the referee comments; /paper revision; Write the response letter for a revision already made; /paper response-letter; Audit my rebuttal; /paper rebuttal-audit | Any stage: Check the citations; Review my draft; Draw the figures; /paper citation-check, a mode; /paper draft-review, a call; /paper figures, a call | Internal documents: A record of every attempt, for my own reference; An outline or a literature review to pass to my co-authors; /paper full, outline-only or abstract-only, with the intake row Internal only set to yes; /paper outline-only or /paper lit-review | No mode: Write the highlights; Describe a graphical abstract.
